format: html

```{r}
# Load libraries and data
library(survey)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(dplyr)

# Analytic dataset 
nhanes_newvars <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "nhanes_bmd_pediatric_newvars_rawoutcome.rds"))
# Releveled race/ethnicity category from P4_BMD_RAW
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>% 
  mutate(race_eth = fct_relevel(RIDRETH3, "Non-Hispanic White"))
```

```{r}
# Survey design 
nhanes_design_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_newvars)

subpop_design <- subset(nhanes_design_full, subpop1 == 1)
```

# New Version

```{r}
nhanes_design_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_newvars)

#Define Subpopulation Eligible for Physical Activity
# Restrict to primary analytic subpop AND those eligible for the PA question (pa_ineligible_flag == 0)
pa_sens_design <- subset(nhanes_design_full, subpop1 == 1 & pa_ineligible_flag == 0 & cycle == "J")

#Run Models on PA-Eligible Subpop

# MALES 
# Model A: Without PA (Baseline model within the PA-eligible subpopulation)
male_model_no_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + INDFMPIR + BMXHT,
  design = subset(pa_sens_design, RIAGENDR == "Male")
)

# Model B: With PA added
male_model_with_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + INDFMPIR + BMXHT + pa_days,
  design = subset(pa_sens_design, RIAGENDR == "Male")
)

summary(male_model_no_pa)
summary(male_model_with_pa)


# FEMALES
# Model A: Without PA (Baseline model within the PA-eligible subpopulation)
female_model_no_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + INDFMPIR + BMXHT,
  design = subset(pa_sens_design, RIAGENDR == "Female")
)

# Model B: With PA added
female_model_with_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + INDFMPIR + BMXHT + pa_days,
  design = subset(pa_sens_design, RIAGENDR == "Female")
)

summary(female_model_no_pa)
summary(female_model_with_pa)
```

# Tables

```{r}
# Tables

# Males: main model vs. PA-sensitivity model, side by side
tbl_male_compare <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(
    tbl_regression(male_model_no_pa, exponentiate = FALSE, include = "factor(screen_quart)",
                   label = list("factor(screen_quart)" = "Screen Quartile"),
                   conf.level = 0.95, conf.int = TRUE),
    tbl_regression(male_model_with_pa, exponentiate = FALSE, include = "factor(screen_quart)",
                   label = list("factor(screen_quart)" = "Screen Quartile"),
                   conf.level = 0.95, conf.int = TRUE)
  ),
  tab_spanner = c("**Main Model**", "**+ Physical Activity**")
) |> as_gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Table A2: Sensitivity Comparison of Physical Activity: Males") |>
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Sensitivity model additionally adjusts for physical activity (days/week ≥60 min activity. Sensitivity analysis only examines cycle J wave data to ensure age criteria is met. Screen time quartile 1 (lowest) served as reference category.\nAbbreviation: CI = Confidence Interval")

tbl_male_compare

# Females: same structure
tbl_female_compare <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(
    tbl_regression(female_model_no_pa, exponentiate = FALSE, include = "factor(screen_quart)",
                   label = list("factor(screen_quart)" = "Screen Quartile"),
                   conf.level = 0.95, conf.int = TRUE),
    tbl_regression(female_model_with_pa, exponentiate = FALSE, include = "factor(screen_quart)",
                   label = list("factor(screen_quart)" = "Screen Quartile"),
                   conf.level = 0.95, conf.int = TRUE)
  ),
  tab_spanner = c("**Main Model**", "**+ Physical Activity**")
) |> as_gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Table A3: Sensitivity Comparison of Physical Activity: Females") |>
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Sensitivity model additionally adjusts for physical activity (days/week ≥60 min activity. Sensitivity analysis only examines cycle J wave data to ensure age criteria is met. Screen time quartile 1 (lowest) served as reference category.\nAbbreviation: CI = Confidence Interval")

tbl_female_compare
```

# Save Tables

```{r}
gt::gtsave(tbl_male_compare, filename = "TableA2_male_compare.png") #save combined as png
gt::gtsave(tbl_female_compare, filename = "TableA3_female_compare.png") 

```
